# Contributing to WhatsApp Blaster

Thank you for contributing! This project is maintained collaboratively with AI coding agents (such as Agent X and Super Z) and human developers.

## Branching Strategy
- `main`: Production-ready releases
- `develop`: Integration branch for tested features
- `feature/<name>`: Feature branch
- `fix/<name>`: Bug fix branch
- `docs/<name>`: Documentation update

## Commit Conventions
Follow Conventional Commits: `<type>(<scope>): <subject>`

- Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `chore`, `ci`, `revert`
- Scopes: `ui`, `api`, `backend`, `ai`, `config`, `docs`, `build`, `test`, `deps`

Always explain **why** changes were made in the commit body.
